description:
Goal

Expose the exact request-local outgoing-edge publisher frontier as one immutable product view of ProductDriver-owned request state.

Signal

- First request for OutgoingInputEdges(E) adds E once and advances the frontier value/generation.
- Duplicate requests and unrelated ProductKeys do not move it.
- Requested-but-waiting publishers remain present after producer unblock.
- OutgoingEdgeFrontier(root) contains only the stable ordered requested keys and no edge data, World-derived metadata, or production-created demand.
- Later first request revises the frontier and generically stales readers before they can return cached partial answers.

Strategy

Record actual requests at ProductDriver::pull, where demand becomes real. Store the exact outgoing key set in driver/session request state and expose it through ProductKey::OutgoingEdgeFrontier(root) using the generic product dependency/generation contract. The product is a view of the driver authority, not a second mutable inventory.

Removals

Delete use of demanded_executables or produced call-edge inventories as publisher-completion authority. Add no World census, target reconstruction, no-change loop, or transport-specific validity stamp.

Acceptance

Real-driver lifecycle/order tests pass with value-sensitive generations and exact dependencies. Documentation names all requested outgoing publishers as the smallest honest currently-carried domain.
title: Expose the requested outgoing-edge publisher frontier as a product
